profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that connects young people from communities underrepresented in health care with mentoring, training and career pathways in medicine and other health fields. Its programs include summer internships, mentorship, pre-apprenticeships and health training and certifications such as CPR and first aid. It was founded in 2006.
